text: Correction to message 47cfb6a7 (COPY FILE/RENAME, #6583/#6585/#6586/#6587): the exact-content transfer suite has 23 cases, not 21. Also, review found wildcard captures were re-encoded from code points and would corrupt invalid-UTF-8 POSIX names; captures are now byte slices of the original name, with new binary-payload and invalid-byte tests. Message 47cfb6a7 is left unchanged (immutable).
